cases.rationale: Local publisher policy: the absolute canonical URL matches the manifest target exactly.
Local publisher policy: resolve a same-directory relative canonical against the document URL.
Local publisher policy: resolve parent-directory traversal within the URL path to the expected canonical.
Local publisher policy: resolve a root-relative canonical on the document origin.
Local publisher policy: resolve a scheme-relative canonical using the document scheme.
Local publisher policy: resolve the canonical through the first head base href.
Local publisher policy: ignore later base href elements after the first head base.
Local publisher policy: accept canonical as one ASCII-whitespace-separated rel token.
Local publisher policy: compare the rel token using ASCII case-insensitive matching.
Local publisher policy: HTML attribute names are ASCII case-insensitive.
Local publisher policy: decode the HTML character reference in href before URL comparison.
Local publisher policy: retain and compare the complete query string.
Local publisher policy: require exactly one canonical link in an explicit head.
Local publisher policy: reject multiple canonical links even when their destinations agree.
Local publisher policy: reject multiple canonical links even when their destinations differ.
Local publisher policy: a canonical link in body is outside the required explicit head.
Local publisher policy: a canonical link must carry a non-empty href destination.
Local publisher policy: an empty href is missing a canonical destination even though URL resolution could return the document URL.
Local publisher policy: reject malformed absolute URL syntax as a canonical destination.
Local publisher policy: canonical destinations must use HTTP(S), not the javascript scheme.
Local publisher policy: canonical destinations must use HTTP(S), not the data scheme.
Local publisher policy: reject a canonical destination containing a fragment.
Local publisher policy: the resolved canonical host must match the manifest target.
Local publisher policy: the resolved canonical path must match the manifest target.
Local publisher policy: the resolved canonical query must match the manifest target without dropping parameters.
Local publisher policy: reject an invalid first head base href used to resolve a relative canonical.
Local publisher policy: markup-looking text in an HTML comment is not a canonical element.
Local publisher policy: markup-looking script text is not a canonical element.
Local publisher policy: inert template content is not an active canonical element.
Local publisher policy: without an explicit head the static document shape is unsupported for this preflight.
Local publisher policy: reject a manifest HTML path containing parent traversal before reading any file.
Local publisher policy: reject symlink HTML input; the symlink is created only in the runtime temporary tree.
